ABEL SHIKANDA
Contact: P.O Box 7905 Nairobi | 0728 157 164 | abelshikanda3@gmail.com
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/abel-shikanda-4a68a582 | GitHub: github.com/abelshikanda
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Versatile Software Developer and Digital Marketing Specialist with over 10 years of experience
building scalable web applications, implementing CI/CD pipelines, and driving data-informed
marketing strategies. Combines technical expertise in full-stack development with strong
analytical skills in business intelligence, SEO, and user behavior analysis. Proven track record
of increasing online engagement, optimizing user experience, and delivering automation
solutions. Currently expanding expertise into algorithmic trading through Expert Advisor (EA)
development using MQL5 and Python.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Category Technologies

Frameworks & Libraries Laravel, Django, Node.js, React.js, Angular, React Native, SASS
Databases MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite
DevOps & Tools Git, GitHub, CI/CD Pipelines, Docker (basic), npm package publishing
Data Analysis & EAs Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, BeautifulSoup, Selenium)
MQL5 (EA development) Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, VBA), Google Analytics, Web Scraping
Digital Marketing SEO/SEM, Google Analytics, Hootsuite, Social Media Marketing, Telegram Bot Development
Networking CCNA (network monitoring, data flow optimization)
WORK EXPERIENCE
June 2016 – Present
Web Developer & Digital Marketing Specialist at Print Shop (printshopeld.com)
- Web Development & E-commerce: Developed and maintained multiple e-commerce and
static websites, increasing online engagement and visibility.
- Data-Driven Marketing: Led digital marketing campaigns using Google Analytics and
Hootsuite, achieving growth in customer acquisition and website traffic.
- UI/UX Optimization: Improved user interface and experience through behavioral
analytics, boosting customer satisfaction by 15% and retention by 20%.
- CI/CD Implementation: Implemented CI/CD pipelines, reducing deployment times by
40%.
- Telegram Marketing Bot: Designed and developed a Telegram bot to automate customer
interactions, track engagement metrics (open rates, CTR, user feedback), and refine
targeting strategies, resulting in 20% improvement in campaign effectiveness.
- Data Dashboarding: Created automated Excel dashboards for sales and marketing
analysis, enabling faster strategic decision-making.
- Web Data Analysis: Collected and analyzed web data using Python (BeautifulSoup,
Selenium) and Google Analytics to identify trends and optimize performance.
October 2024 – Present
Systems Programmer & DevOps for JK Enterprises (jke-tech.com)
- Web Development: Developed and maintained company and static websites, increasing
online engagement by 20%.
- CI/CD Pipeline Management: Implemented CI/CD pipelines, reducing deployment times
by 60%.
- Automation & Scripting: Built and published BakTrack, an npm package for local
versioned backups, improving backup redundancy, speed, and reliability.
June 2020 – June 2021
Marketing Assistant at Amash Tender Touch Supplies Limited
- Integrated digital marketing platforms using tracking pixels and analytics, enhancing
customer engagement by 35%.
- Utilized market and sales data to inform product activation strategies, contributing to
10% increase in sales.
- Developed customer retention strategies, achieving 20% repeat business rate.
SKILL HIGHLIGHT: ALGORITHMIC TRADING (EA DEVELOPMENT)
- MQL5: Developing Expert Advisors (EAs) for automated trading on MetaTrader 5,
including signal generation, risk management, and backtesting optimization.
- Python for Finance: Using Python libraries (Pandas, NumPy) for historical data analysis,
strategy backtesting, and integrating with trading APIs.
- Goal: Combine software development and data analysis skills to build robust,
data-driven automated trading systems.
